title: FairStake
tagline: Proof of person, not passport — reusable investor credentials for sybil-resistant fair launches.
description:
Fair launches get sybil-farmed. Full KYC is overkill for small pools. FairStake separates human eligibility from capital commitment.

Investors prove they're a unique live human via World Selfie Check — one nullifier, enforced on-chain. They receive a portable investor passport (ENS-shaped credentials on Sepolia) with max commit and expiry. They then commit USDC into fair-launch pools on Arc Testnet with per-investor caps.

Unverified wallets fail closed. The Sybil Test: verified investor commits → fresh wallet reverts → same passport works on Round 2 without a second selfie.

Proof of person, not proof of passport.
how_its_made:
Built with Scaffold-ETH 2 (Next.js + Hardhat). Smart contracts: FairStakePool on Arc Testnet (USDC commits, nullifier reuse guard, fail-closed gating) and InvestorPassportRegistry on Sepolia (ENS-shaped text records).

World IDKit v4 + RP signing server for Selfie Check; verified nullifiers flow through /api/world/verify → /api/credential/issue, which writes credentials on-chain via the deployer verifier key.

Frontend: Judge Theater with Sybil Attack Theater (50-bot simulation), KYC Treadmill vs Passport contrast, and live commit flow on Arc. Deployed on Arc (0x53fa…3766) and Sepolia (0x53fa…3766). 5 passing Hardhat tests.
